div.ab: be folgeran . Folgere gebyreð þæt he ontwelf Monðum .ii . æceras geearnige oðerne gesawene 7 oðerne unsawene sædige sylf ðæne . 7 his mete . 7 scoung 7 glofung him gebyreð gyf he mare gearnian mæig him bið sylfum fremu.

Concerning the follower [of the plough] For the follower [of the plough] it is fitting that he earns two acres in twelve months, the one sown and the other unsown that [he should] sow it himself, and his food and shoes and gloves are due to him; if he ploughs more may it be to his own advantage.

[10] Be folgeran. Folgere gebyreð, þæt he on twelf monðum II æceras geearnige, oðerne gesawene 7 oðerne unsawene; sædige sylf ðæne; 7 his mete 7 scoung 7 glofung him gebyreð. [10.1] Gyf he mare gearnian mæig him bið sylfum fremu.
